decision_policy.PASS: All registered local controls pass, external read-only controls are positively observed, protected science is unchanged, reproducible assets satisfy exact relations, and the release-state transition is explicit and fail-closed.
decision_policy.FAIL: Any registered compatibility, integrity, security, reproducibility or protected-artifact condition is observably violated.
decision_policy.BLOCKED: A mandatory control is unknown, unavailable, or depends on an owner decision not granted for this task.
decision_policy.hosted_acceptance_rule: Local evidence may be technically PASS but readiness remains NOT_READY until hosted assurance succeeds for the exact candidate commit.
